subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw persist a formal compaction trigger/cause field and require trusted context snapshots before successful-turn overflow compaction in yielded/subagent wake paths?
rationale: The behavioral guard is a bug fix, but the requested attribution field changes persisted transcript metadata and needs an owner-approved shape.

options.title: Add trigger metadata and harden overflow input
options.body: Persist a bounded compaction cause enum and prevent successful-turn overflow compaction from trusting aggregate input when no context snapshot or explicit provider overflow signal exists.

options.title: Only harden overflow input
options.body: Fix the likely spurious compaction trigger first and leave persisted attribution for a separate diagnostics design.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Accept the current fallback input heuristic and rely on logs/tests rather than transcript metadata for attribution.

recommendation.title: Add trigger metadata and harden overflow input
recommendation.body: Persist a bounded compaction cause enum and prevent successful-turn overflow compaction from trusting aggregate input when no context snapshot or explicit provider overflow signal exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-history route from the central compaction and session files, though ownership is shared with runtime/context contributors.
